newsitem.title: USA: Cellular Tech comfortable with forecast.
newsitem.headline: Cellular Tech comfortable with forecast.

text.p: Cellular Technical Services Co Inc, a provider of real-time information management systems for wireless communications, said on Monday it is comfortable with financial analysts' consensus estimates it can earn $0.75 a share on $75 million of sales in 1997.

In a statement, the company said its product called "Blackbird," which helps the wireless industry combat fraud, could potentially be deployed on more than 25,000 cell sites in the United States and over 40,000 outside the country. And the number of potential sites is growing by 10 percent a year.
